verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is built to be driven through the user's own AI agent. Users tell the agent what they want, and the agent runs the managed processes for incorporation, hiring, payroll and the like over the official remote MCP server or the agent-oriented `--json` CLI. The docs show conversational use, for example asking the agent to call MCP `status`, and the get-started page shows an agent replying to the user's requirements. Ultrametric runs no model itself, so natural-language operation depends on a third-party agent host the user already pays for. missing for 10: a native natural-language interface that needs no external agent, documented natural-language command examples beyond the marketing snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration.
